title: Cursor Agent cannot see CSV, PDF, SVG, or image files in the project
symptoms: Agent reports that a data file cannot be read although it is in the workspace
Lock files, node_modules, and .venv are invisible to Agent
cause: On top of .gitignore and .cursorignore, Cursor applies a built-in ignore list that includes *.csv, *.pdf, *.svg, common image, audio, video, and archive types, lock files, and folders such as node_modules and .venv.
fix: Re-include the files Agent needs with a ! pattern in .cursorignore.
